about: Reviewed .query() sites whose SQL text tests/sql-text-lint.ts cannot show to be constant (SQL-injection audit B, 29.10.2026, docs/parity/SQL-INJECTION-AUDIT-B-20261029.md). key = sha256(16 hex) of the whitespace-normalised SQL-text argument: any edit of the expression breaks the entry and needs a new review. An entry that no longer matches a dynamic site fails the test.

Projection `${scalarSql[k]} AS ${k}`: k comes from q.columns, a z.array(z.enum(CATALOG_EXPORT_COLUMNS keys)) (server/catalog-export.ts:56,63), filtered by scalarSql[k]; every k is a fixed column key and scalarSql values are constants.
LIMIT ${CATALOG_EXPORT_LIMITS.products + 1}: a module constant object of numbers; the lint only fails because the object is also returned in a response (alias), which cannot change it.

Column `${kind}` = config.identity. config is the zod-parsed request (identity: z.enum(['id','sku','ean','name']), server/catalog-file-import-schema.ts:89) or the same config stored by this app in the preview row and re-hashed against the parsed request (catalog-file-import-eligibility.ts:23). Not writable by a request; sku takes another branch. Second-order only if a row could be forged by SQL, which this audit rules out.
